title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Robust Hybrid Algorithm Design and Implementation for Real-Time Detection of Plant Diseases in Agricultural Environments.
summary: A hybrid learned plant-disease detector was tested on field images and embedded in a UAV workflow across apple, grape and tomato sites, with reported class errors and runtime comparisons. This is a specific field detection result.
